cells.value: The Supplier's manufacturing, testing, finishing, and supplying line pipe to Company and the facilities at which these activities are conducted.
The planned and systematic actions that is necessary to ensure quality and provide confidence that a product or service is fit for its intended purpose.

The organizations structure, responsibilities, activities, resources, and events that together provide organized procedures and methods of implementation to ensure the capability of an organization to comply with quality requirements.
A document set out general quality policies, procedures, and practices of an organization.
A document prepared by the manufacturer or Supplier that sets out the specific quality practices, resources, and activities relevant to a particular contract or order.
Pipes without a welded seam that was produced by a hot forming process without the application of any cold finishing or cold sizing unless approved otherwise by the Company.
The Vendor manufacturing, refining and casting steel to slab for subsequent plate manufacture and the premises where these activities are carried out.
A trading house or steel merchant acting on behalf of the manufacturer or pipe mill, to which an enquiry has been issued or to which a Purchase Order or contract to supply line pipe has been awarded.
